purpose: Odoo WFM/manufacturing semantic value mapping and next proof action.

automationOpportunities: bootstrap workforce, organisation, manufacturing, maintenance, quality, inventory and finance mappings from one Odoo database when the relevant apps are present, reducing small-manufacturer implementation effort
join skills, attendance/time-off and planning shifts to manufacturing-order/work-centre demand to flag qualified labour shortages before overtime or agency labour is committed

join maintenance/work-centre blocking evidence to labour plans so employees are not scheduled or paid idle against equipment that cannot run, while preserving maintenance as operational evidence rather than payroll truth
join quality failures/rework evidence to actual attendance and labour cost for rework-labour attribution and training/skill-gap hypotheses without claiming causation
join inventory/purchasing availability to workforce capacity to distinguish material-constrained orders from true labour constraints and avoid unnecessary overtime/agency spend
join authoritative WFM payroll/attendance cost to Odoo production/analytic/valuation evidence for labour-per-order/good-unit and finance attribution without treating ERP costs as payroll authority

use exact database/model metadata and source-scope discovery to configure micro manufacturers with near-zero mappings while isolating multi-database, multi-company and acquisition estates on the same fabric
savingsHypotheses: reduce implementation effort for Odoo manufacturers by discovering the exact database schema/apps once and reusing the same JSON-2/RPC read fabric instead of building module-by-module point integrations
reduce avoidable overtime and agency labour by separating labour shortages from time-off, qualification, maintenance and material constraints before shift decisions are finalised
reduce payroll and costing exceptions by reconciling attendance/shift evidence with authoritative WFM pay rules while preserving Odoo production and analytic dimensions for attribution
reduce paid idle time and improve throughput by aligning work-centre availability, maintenance blocking, material readiness and qualified labour in the same provenance-aware semantic layer
reduce rework cost by linking quality outcomes to the skills, training and labour context present when work was executed, while retaining competing changes and avoiding causal overclaim
causalOutcomeReadiness: preserve connection, host, database, company, model, source record id, Odoo version, schema fingerprint, source/effective timestamps and per-call observation windows on every mapped record
preserve recommendation and action ids plus baseline/outcome windows when people are redeployed, overtime is changed, training is assigned or maintenance timing changes

retain competing changes such as material receipts, work-centre downtime, maintenance completion, routing/BOM changes, quality events, production quantity changes and schema/module upgrades so outcomes are not falsely attributed to staffing decisions
valueReview.nextDevelopmentAction: Use an authorised Odoo 19 Custom-plan sandbox/test database to prove a dedicated non-admin bot user, bearer key plus rotation/revocation, /doc and exact model/field discovery, database/company source scoping, exact read-via-POST allowlists, denied create/write/unlink/action/key-management methods, bounded search_read pagination and overlap recovery, custom-field/schema drift, 401/403/429/5xx diagnostics, per-call observation-window reconciliation, and real employee/planning/attendance/manufacturing/work-centre/maintenance/quality/inventory/finance reads where those apps are installed. Test private/on-prem only through an authorised customer edge and keep all business/payroll mutations disabled.
